business_problem: Hypergryph needed a more stable and elastic way to handle high-frequency game telemetry, scheduling, and BI workloads because its legacy platform struggled with shuffle-heavy jobs, scheduler integration, and provider support.
solution_summary: Hypergryph uses EMR Serverless Spark, Realtime Compute for Apache Flink, EMR Serverless StarRocks, and Object Storage Service (OSS) to support global game analytics for live-service operations. Hypergryph needed a more stable and elastic way to handle high-frequency game telemetry, scheduling, and BI workloads because its legacy platform struggled with shuffle-heavy jobs, scheduler integration, and provider support. In practice, the implementation ingests source data through Realtime Compute for Apache Flink, stores or organizes core datasets in Object Storage Service (OSS), runs transformation or AI logic on EMR Serverless Spark, and delivers outputs through EMR Serverless StarRocks. Streaming operational telemetry and business events are consolidated into Object Storage Service (OSS); EMR Serverless Spark applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through EMR Serverless StarRocks. business_outcome: Hypergryph reported 50% reduction, from 30 minutes to 15 minutes., and accelerated by 1.5 hours, improving global game analytics for live-service operations with measurable gains in productivity improvement, scalability, and speed to market.
